name: REX Sensor Triggering
description: Request-to-Exit sensors are positioned on the interior side of access-controlled doors and automatically release the electric lock when someone approaches from inside. Modern dual-technology REX sensors combine PIR with microwave or ultrasonic detection — these are significantly harder to defeat with static objects and should be confirmed as single-tech before attempting defeat. Many can be triggered from the exterior by inserting a thin nozzle through the door gap and directing a burst of compressed air at the sensor. The RTT REX Blaster is specifically designed for this application. This technique bypasses the entire access control system without any credential, picking, or electronic attack.

blue.det: Access control log shows door open without valid credential read; camera footage of exterior showing tool or foreign object near door.
blue.cm: Dual-technology REX sensors (PIR + microwave) cannot be defeated with static objects; configure access control to alert on door open without credential read; camera coverage of REX side.
